CalendarManager dialog — workweek editor, exception date management

Memo export — PDF (jsPDF) and Word-compatible HTML download

timeline.label: XER→PMXML pivot — comment declares XER removal intent
timeline.pivot_detail: File header comment changed from 'Maps parsed P6 inputs (.xer or PMXML)' to 'Maps a parsed PMXML file … XER ingest was removed'. Signals start of XER excision.
timeline.notes: Pivot step 1 of 3. Functional behaviour unchanged at this point.

timeline.label: XER→PMXML pivot — all XER-specific mapper code deleted
capabilities_removed: XER PROJWBS / TASK / TASKPRED / TASKRSRC / RSRC / CALENDAR mapping
timeline.pivot_detail: 197 lines of XER mapper code deleted. Replaced by single-line tombstone comment '// (XER-specific mappers removed — PMXML is now the sole ingest format.)'
timeline.notes: Pivot step 2 of 3. XER code path no longer callable.

timeline.label: XER→PMXML pivot — detectAndImport hardcoded to PMXML only
timeline.pivot_detail: detectAndImport(filename, text) renamed param to _filename (unused), body replaced with unconditional return importFromPmxml(text). JSDoc: 'PMXML is the sole ingest format.'
timeline.notes: Pivot step 3 of 3. Pivot complete — XER fully dead. Matches pivot-detector anchor.

timeline.label: DcmaPanel wired into ScheduleWorkspace
capabilities_introduced: DcmaPanel receives activities, relationships, meta props
